limits: Not a full App mount or real provider request.
Finite upstream cells may themselves omit skipped contracts; frontend has no contract-level coverage to detect that.
Sparse absence does not distinguish unlisted contracts from unavailable inputs; neither is assumed measured zero.
Externally supplied node-strip Air levels remain upstream-owned and are not recomputed by this fix.
